blocks.content: Quiz: In this lesson, what does the cleanup function returned from useEffect() do?
Tap an option below to answer:
It prevents the effect from running more than once
The dependency array controls when the effect runs. The cleanup only handles what happens when the effect stops.
The dependency array controls when the effect runs. The cleanup only handles what happens when the effect stops.
It resets the ref to null after the component renders
React manages the ref lifecycle automatically. The cleanup is for the external event listener we added.
React manages the ref lifecycle automatically. The cleanup is for the external event listener we added.
It closes the drawer by setting selectedEntry to null
The cleanup only manages the event listener. Closing the drawer is handled by calling onClose() inside the listener itself.
The cleanup only manages the event listener. Closing the drawer is handled by calling onClose() inside the listener itself.
It removes the mousedown listener from the document when the component unmounts or the effect re-runs
Without cleanup, each render adds a new listener. The cleanup ensures only one is active at a time.
Without cleanup, each render adds a new listener. The cleanup ensures only one is active at a time.
